title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Multimodal Design-to-Code Engineering Model
summary: A native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model by Zhipu AI designed for autonomous frontend code generation from layouts. It excels at converting screenshots or sketches into functional code and supports complex visual debugging tasks.
research_notes: Achieved a 94.8 score on the Design2Code benchmark, notably outperforming Claude Opus 4.6. The model is trained entirely on a domestic Chinese hardware stack using Huawei Ascend chips.

evolution.summary: Following the April 2026 release of GLM-5V-Turbo, Zhipu AI introduced GLM-5.1 in May 2026. This update shifted focus toward 'Agentic Engineering,' enabling autonomous end-to-end repository generation and complex terminal-based development tasks.
